sources.title: Integrated Task and Motion Planning in Belief Space
sources.authors: Leslie Pack Kaelbling and Tomas Lozano-Perez
sources.design_relevance: Acting, sensing and task planning under uncertainty are established research topics; use explicit beliefs and action consequences.

sources.title: CLEVR: A Diagnostic Dataset for Compositional Language and Elementary Visual Reasoning
sources.design_relevance: Controlled rendered data can expose shortcuts, compositional errors and attribute-distribution shifts. CausalFill includes no CLEVR data or code.

sources.title: ManiSkill observation modes
sources.design_relevance: Separate privileged scene state from raw sensor observations in future simulator integration.

sources.title: ManiSkill3: GPU Parallelized Robotics Simulation and Rendering for Generalizable Embodied AI
sources.design_relevance: A contact-rich simulator is a materially different experimental layer from a dependency-free 2D raster fixture. No ManiSkill run is claimed.

implementation_provenance: New renderer, tasks, certificate code and tests are original AI-assisted project code under the existing MIT license. Research sources inform design; their code, datasets and assets are not copied.
claim_boundary: Prior art was checked for grounding, not an exhaustive novelty search. No first-ever or state-of-the-art ranking claim follows.
